scope: Neutral requirements first, then full Review A1-A8; no supplied verdicts.

groups.requirement: Canonical selected worker module, explicit scratch/request root and connected framed stdin/stdout/stderr with bounded concurrent drains. Actual installed launch/exchange and cancel/reap proof at I3, no new pre-coding experiment.
Read responsiveness/cancel/drain witnesses at I3-C4, agreeing with permitted lifecycle edits; basic content/refusal tests at I3-C3.

Exact capability deployment-manifest discovery/precedence/schema/route binding and public resolver in existing I1/I2 paths; unchanged model YAML parseable, supported defaults positively resolve from provisioned local assets. No serving/parity gate.

retained_requirements: Configured records with optional evidence, injected broker, post-build worker acceptance, exact shared lifecycle, unchanged source scope and current maintainer decisions.
